claims.text: Screen readers read the semantics tree Flutter builds alongside the widget tree; each Text contributes its own semantics node unless merged or excluded.
Semantics with a label and excludeSemantics: true replaces the descendants' semantics with that one label.
Material/Flutter guidance: tap targets should be at least 48x48 logical pixels.
claims.source_hint: Flutter docs: accessibility (tap target size); Material guidelines

claims.text: ProductTile@stage-1: Semantics(label: name, price đồng; button: onTap != null; excludeSemantics: true) around InkWell > ConstrainedBox(minHeight: 48) > Padding(12) > Row(Expanded(Text(name)), Text(price đ)); ProductCatalog passes no onTap.
The accessibility widget test checks the first tile is at least 48 tall and that find.bySemanticsLabel finds "Bàn phím cơ, 1250000 đồng"; it passes.
BoxConstraints(minHeight: 48) sets only a lower bound; the tile may grow taller, e.g. when text wraps.
Accessibility is cheaper built into small widgets than fixed across screens later; small targets are hard to hit for anyone with limited precision.
